answer: We plant jobs whose correct answer is already known and quietly wrong in one detail: a reef of them, cheap to grade, none announced as a test. An identity that returns the flawed answer gets burned on the spot and its sponsor loses the trellis of referrals hanging off it. Trust attaches to a finished walnut-sized task, not to an address, so a thousand registrations buy nothing until each one passes work nobody published. That is the bill, one paid job per fake account.
